description: This file defines custom exception classes and error handling logic for Spark SQL pipelines, including exceptions for unresolved datasets, load failures, pipeline resolution issues, and circular dependencies, as well as error checking utilities within the PipelinesErrors object.

classes.name: UnresolvedDatasetException
classes.description: Exception for unresolved datasets during read operations in a pipeline.

classes.name: LoadTableException
classes.description: Exception for failures when loading a table within the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelinesErrors
classes.description: Object containing error handling utilities and streaming error checks.

classes.name: UnresolvedPipelineException
classes.description: Exception indicating a pipeline has unresolved flows or errors.

classes.name: CircularDependencyException
classes.description: Exception for circular dependencies between tables in a pipeline.

methods.name: getExceptionChain
methods.description: Retrieves the chain of causes from an exception.

methods.name: checkCauses
methods.description: Checks if an exception or any of its causes meet a condition.

methods.name: checkStreamingErrorsAndRetry
methods.description: Handles streaming errors, logs, and determines whether to retry or stop execution.
